title: Lies of P: Complete Edition
description: Lies of P: Complete Edition is the Nintendo Switch 2 release of NEOWIZ’s acclaimed soulslike. It includes the full base game and the Overture expansion, combining the fall of Krat with the prequel story that reveals more about the Puppet Frenzy. Combat centers on precise guarding, weapon assembly, Legion Arms, boss mastery, and dark Belle Époque atmosphere.
